description: This file defines the SubjectInvalidException class, a specialized runtime exception used in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.messages package to signal invalid subject strings, typically when they do not conform to specified URI regex patterns. It includes methods for construction, JSON deserialization, and building with a builder pattern.

classes.name: SubjectInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents exceptions related to invalid subjects, with static methods for creation, deserialization, and modification, and a nested Builder class.

methods.name: SubjectInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with the invalid subject, formatting message and setting default description.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance for constructing a SubjectInvalidException with a specific subject.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a SubjectInvalidException from a simple message (deprecated).

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a SubjectInvalidException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a SubjectInvalidException from a JSON object with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
